name: ecs-flavor-boot
question: Does an ECS of flavor ${flavor} boot the image ${image} in ${az} and read ACTIVE with that flavor and AZ, after cond:operation:az of the flavor says normal for ${az}?
about: First the extra specs of the flavor: cond:operation:az must say normal for the AZ, else the run stops before any create. Then a VPC with a subnet, a security group without extra rules and one server of the flavor in the AZ. The checks: the server reaches ACTIVE within 10 minutes and reads the flavor and the AZ of the parameters. Last the console of the server is read for up to 5 minutes; an empty console (the s9 family gave 0 bytes for 8 minutes in the pilot of 2026-10-14, s3 wrote one) is reported in the evidence and does not fail the run.

flavor.help: the flavor under test: any family the deny list does not refuse (GPU and AI families, sizes above 2xlarge, physical flavors), up to 2xlarge; the s9 family is admitted

image.help: the name of a public image

admin_secret.help: the name of the tenant secret that fills adminPass; the run checks it is there before its first create

steps.says: read the extra specs of the flavor before any create
steps.confirm: GET /v2.1/{project_id}/flavors/ID/os-extra_specs and the key cond:operation:az under extra_specs in the form eu-de-01(normal),eu-de-02(sellout); the pilot read the same key from the flavor list

steps.says: find the public image by its name
steps.confirm: the name and __imagetype=gold filters of GET /v2/cloudimages, as in ecs-boot-ssh

steps.name: ${name}
steps.confirm: the tag call POST /v2.0/{project_id}/vpcs/ID/tags/action, as in ecs-boot-ssh

steps.name: ${name}
steps.confirm: the find GET /v1/{project_id}/subnets with the vpc_id filter, as in ecs-boot-ssh

steps.says: a security group in the VPC
steps.name: ${name}
steps.confirm: POST and the find of /v1/{project_id}/security-groups, as in ecs-boot-ssh

steps.says: the server of the flavor under test
steps.name: ${name}-a

resource.type: ecs server with its system disk

steps.confirm: the create body of ecs-boot-ssh with the flavor of the parameter
the flavor under server.flavor.id and the AZ under server.OS-EXT-AZ:availability_zone of GET /v1/{project_id}/cloudservers/ID

steps.says: read the console of the server for up to 5 minutes
steps.confirm: POST /v2/{project_id}/servers/ID/action with os-getConsoleOutput, as in ecs-boot-ssh; the login prompt as the sign of a console that writes

checks.says: cond:operation:az of the flavor says normal for the AZ before the create
the image is known in the region
the server reaches ACTIVE within 10 minutes
the server reads the flavor of the parameter
the server reads the AZ of the parameter
the console shows a login prompt within 5 minutes; an empty console is reported, not failed

vpc.confirm: a VPC delete may answer 409 VPC.0104 while its subnet is still going; the teardown repeats the delete until it is taken

server.confirm: POST /v1/{project_id}/cloudservers/delete with delete_volume, as in ecs-boot-ssh

kb.statement: An ECS of flavor ${flavor} boots the public image ${image} in ${az} and reads ACTIVE with that flavor and AZ when cond:operation:az of the flavor says normal for ${az}.
